## Custom GUI Mod v1.1.3

This release focuses on the rune GUI, player interface structure, interaction polish, and CI reliability.

### Added
- Added a redesigned player and rune interface layout.
- Added a 16-slot equipment UI skeleton and 5 equipment loadouts.
- Added rune search by name and type.
- Added rune purchase quantities: `x1`, `x5`, `x10`, `x100`.
- Added rune action hints.
- Added background blur for the GUI.
- Added player progression placeholders.

### Fixed
- Restored rune awakening interactions and maximum-rank state handling.
- Fixed scaled rune hit detection.
- Fixed GUI blur ownership so the screen only clears the shader it loaded.
- Fixed GitHub Actions artifact naming for feature branches.
- Improved purchase control spacing and amount label rendering.

### Other
- Simplified the right-side navigation to the rune tab and close button.
- Added CI protection against permission-pending GUI assets and fonts.
- Kept equipment and loadouts as UI-only placeholders for future gameplay mechanics.
- Permission-pending GUI assets and fonts are not included in this public release.

### Download
Use the attached `customguimod-1.1.3.jar`.

Required resource pack:
[RE:volution Resource Pack v1.1.0](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-resource-pack/releases/tag/v1.1.0)

Choose either:
- `re-volution-resource-pack-v1.1.0-64x64.zip`
- `re-volution-resource-pack-v1.1.0-128x128.zip`
